bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
P=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
SQL="SELECT 'ENTRY|'||p.chat_id||'|'||p.message_thread_id||'|'||replace(p.title,'|','/')||'|'||p.state||'|'||coalesce(to_char(p.updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'),'')||'|'||coalesce(string_agg(DISTINCT t.purpose,','),'UNREGISTERED') FROM topic_dm_entry_pins p LEFT JOIN posting_topics t ON t.chat_id=p.chat_id AND t.message_thread_id=p.message_thread_id WHERE p.message_thread_id IN (273,4,18,1695,1724,4291) OR p.updated_at >= '2026-11-13T15:45:00Z' GROUP BY p.chat_id,p.message_thread_id,p.title,p.state,p.updated_at ORDER BY p.chat_id,p.message_thread_id; SELECT 'PANEL|'||p.chat_id||'|'||p.message_thread_id||'|'||p.panel_type||'|'||p.state FROM board_menu_panels p WHERE p.panel_type IN ('general_guide','posting') ORDER BY p.chat_id,p.message_thread_id;"
RESULT=$(docker compose -p deploy -f "$P/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" exec -T postgres psql -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "$SQL" 2>&1) || exit 32
gh issue comment 7 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body "$(printf 'POSTING_BUTTON_EXCLUSION_CLASSIFICATION_20261113\n%s' "$RESULT")" >/dev/null || exit 33
echo EXCLUDED_TOPIC_CLASSIFICATION_RECORDED
